comment: The chain graph as exported from GGML (chain.workload.json beside this file, origin.kind=ggml), with the ACCEPTANCE.md 1 common costs: H2D 3 ms, MUL_MAT 2 ms, workspace 0, reserve 0, alignment 1. It differs from examples/chain-cap160.json only in which workload document it points at -- the id is the same because the scenario is the same scenario. The two must therefore produce the same optimum, which is what tests/test_ggml.py checks.
